question: The Nabakalebara festival is observed at the Jagannath Temple, Odisha. In this festival, new idols are made from neem logs and are replaced during the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adhik Masa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nabakalebara **is a festival observed at the** Jagannath Temple** in **Puri, Odisha.**
 
• During this festival, the old idols of **Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra** are replaced with new ones.
 
• The new idols are made from neem logs and are known as **Daru Brahma.**
 
• The festival is held once in every **12-19 years** when an extra month **(Adhik Masa)** is added to the Hindu calendar.
 
• The last Nabakalebara festival was held in** 2015.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paryushana** is a **Jain festival** that is observed to** purify the soul through** self-discipline and fasting. 

 
 
• According to the Hindi calendar, it is normally observed in **August or September. **
 
 
 
• **Dasveh Patshah** refers to the** ten Sikh gurus** and their teachings. 
 
 
• It is celebrated by **Sikhs **all over the world.
 
• The Sikhs celebrate this day on** January 31st **of each year.
 
 
 
• **Maun Agiyaras** is a Hindu festival in** Gujarat **where people observe a day of silence and fasting to seek blessings from** Lord Krishna.**
 
 
• **​**It occurs on the** eleventh day** of the** Magshar month.**
